notes.title: Changelog Pre-Alpha Build V0.1.3
notes.content:
We'd like to ask all Pre-Alpha players to test this update to find and fix any issues regarding performance or gameplay.
If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions, please contact us in our forums: [url=https://excore.de/forum/index.php?thread/37-changelog-pre-alpha-build-v0-1-3/]Forum Thread[/url]
[list]
[*] Fixed some lighting bugs
[*] Fixed random deaths while jumping
[*] Improved collision detection
[*] Collision detection for the elevator reworked (needs to be monitored further)
[*] Reworked grenades and added more variations (HE, Sticky, Smoke)
[*] Class menu on death and round start
[*] Improved menu (Performance/ Nativizing)
[*] Adjusted projectile positioning (Muzzle)
[*] Leaning added
[*] Sniper Breathing System added
[*] Grenade Cooking added
[*] Compass Objective Marker added
[*] Ability Cooldown added
[*] Damage Indicator improved
[*] Melee Attack added
[*] Bots improved
[*] New ability jetpack added (Needs to be monitored further)
[*] Added new weapon models (no animations yet)
[*] Added Deathmatch & Team Deathmatch modes
[*] Prepared new UI
[/list]
